description: Handle a timed-out clarification question. If timeout_action is 'use_assumption', resumes the task with the assumption value. If 'fail', cancels the task. Triggered automatically by clarification.timeout EventBus events.

checkpoint_id.description: The checkpoint_id of the timed-out suspended task.

question_id.description: The pending_question_id from the timed-out checkpoint.

question.description: The original question that timed out (for logging).

assumption.description: The fallback assumption to inject if timeout_action is 'use_assumption'.

timeout_action.description: Action to take: 'use_assumption' (resume with assumption) or 'fail' (cancel task).
